ankle_inner_right_1.allowanceReason: The gusset end face on the bed carries the real 12 x 1.1 mm recess of the stock bracket (community-66/64 notch beside the gusset hole); the inner half keeps the other part of it on the same end face. Bambu Studio loops the 4 mm outer brim into it: 2.4 mm2 inside the convex outline, a strip bonded on three sides, cut it out with a blade. Orca puts support feet there instead. Same notch as the V1.22 bases (13.3 mm2 there). Not an opening filled with brim.
